svg.title: SharpForge architecture and implementation languages
svg.desc: Layered diagram. Almost every part, including the C# compiler, the IL emitter, both interpreters, the garbage collector, the base class library, the WinUI layer and the IDE, is written in JavaScript. Numeric SIMD kernels are C compiled to WebAssembly, WebGPU rendering uses WGSL shaders, the Studio shell uses HTML and CSS, and a Rust runtime and collector compiled to WebAssembly is planned.
svg.text: A complete C# and .NET toolchain written in JavaScript — the compiler, IL emitter, runtime, garbage collector and IDE run in any browser with no native code
